title: SAIT-EMA: A Tridimensional Electromagnetic Articulography Database for Mandarin with Diverse Language Backgrounds
manual_annotation_evidence: Primary synchronized EMA+audio; session logs used to manually screen/remove misaligned tokens and unintentional repetitions; erroneous tokens and sensor/head-position failures were re-recorded. However phonetic TextGrids are explicitly MFA-generated and authors advise manual verification/refinement for high-precision landmarks.
language_l1_l2: Mandarin; 12 native + 6 L2 learners (Vietnamese, Spanish/Peruvian, Russian, Mexican)
annotation_scope: Raw 3-D EMA trajectories from TT/TB/TD/UL/LL/LI plus reference sensors; synchronized 48 kHz/16-bit mono WAV; stimulus/session metadata; automatic MFA syllable/initial/final TextGrids excluded from manual core
reason: Potentially qualifying only at the exhaustively human-screened token/recording and raw measurement layer; automatic TextGrid boundaries do not qualify. Keep out of core until repository payload is enumerated and manual screening provenance can be represented without implying manual landmark annotation.
next_action: Enumerate Zenodo payload and POS/WAV/session-log structure; ingest source-faithful raw EMA only if manual verification criterion is judged sufficient; quarantine MFA TextGrids as automatic; preserve full trajectories and sensor sampling metadata.
